summary: Frontend-only testing of Optowire Angular 21 SSR catalog Search-as-you-type feature. All 8 requested features pass. One pre-existing catalog race condition documented (catalog.ts has two concurrent loadProducts() calls - one from paramMap, one from queryParamMap - that can race and cause unfiltered results to display). Search dropdown (6 results, name/image/brand), loading spinner, Escape/Enter/outside-click behaviors all work correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Enter key search → catalog page filtering
integration_issues.issue: catalog.ts has a race condition: paramMap.subscribe fires loadProducts() with empty searchQuery, then queryParamMap.subscribe sets searchQuery and fires loadProducts() again. The two concurrent HTTP requests can complete out of order — the all-products response (1138) sometimes arrives AFTER the filtered response, overwriting the correct filtered results. Manifests when navigating from a non-catalog page to /catalog?q=<term>. Intermittent: cable search (608) can show correctly due to API response caching, while fiber (expected 593) shows 1138.

action_items: FIX catalog.ts race condition: replace separate paramMap+queryParamMap subscriptions with combineLatest([this.route.paramMap, this.route.queryParamMap]) so loadProducts() is called ONCE with all resolved params. Currently paramMap calls loadProducts() with empty searchQuery, then queryParamMap calls it again with the actual query — whichever HTTP response arrives last wins, causing intermittent unfiltered results.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (MEDIUM): catalog.ts lines 66-86 — Two independent route subscriptions each call loadProducts(). paramMap fires first with no search, then queryParamMap fires setting searchQuery. These create two racing HTTP requests. Fix: use combineLatest([this.route.paramMap, this.route.queryParamMap]) → load once with all params resolved.
NOTE: All 8 search-as-you-type features work correctly per requirements. The race condition affects the downstream catalog page, not the header search component itself.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 features PASS (100%). Catalog filter race condition is a pre-existing/downstream issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 21 SSR app at catalog-preview-13.preview.emergentagent.com. All header search features work. Pre-existing race condition in catalog.ts: two parallel route subscriptions (paramMap + queryParamMap) each call loadProducts(), causing race between empty-query and filtered-query HTTP responses. Fix: combineLatest. API proxy strips Origin/Referer (server.ts fix from iter 4). Search uses ProductService.explore({productName, page, limit}). Test terms: 'cable' (608 results), 'fiber' (expected 593), all products = 1138.

rca_of_issue.title: Catalog page race condition — two concurrent loadProducts() calls
rca_of_issue.root_cause: catalog.ts ngOnInit subscribes to both paramMap and queryParamMap separately. When navigating from an external page to /catalog?q=fiber: (1) paramMap fires → calls loadProducts() with searchQuery='' → HTTP GET all 1138 products starts; (2) queryParamMap fires → sets searchQuery='fiber' → calls loadProducts() again → HTTP GET 593 filtered products starts. If the all-products response arrives after the filtered response, it overwrites the displayed results with 1138 unfiltered products.
reproduction_steps: Click in header search, type 'fiber', press Enter
Results may show 1138 instead of ~593 due to race
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Replace separate subscriptions with: combineLatest([this.route.paramMap, this.route.queryParamMap]).subscribe(([params, queryParams]) => { const search = queryParams.get('q') || queryParams.get('search'); this.searchQuery = search || ''; const categorySlug = params.get('categorySlug'); /* ... then call loadProducts() once */ })
